tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// dbyangs can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'jig rten mes po'i zhal gyi chu skyes las// legs 'khrungs ngang pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma// bdag gi yid mtshor rtag tu rol cig dang*// khyod nyid sgrub pa'i rim pa bdag gis bshad// de yang lha mo dbyangs can ma dkar mo sgrub par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ rang skad cig gis lha mo dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīṃḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i lha mo dbyangs can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la/ oṃ swa ra swa tī arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs kyis sdom pa bzung*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi don dran pa'i sgo nas ngag du brjod pas/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid dang rang gi sems ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīṃḥdakar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon pas dri za'i pi wang rgyud stong dang ldan pa dku g.yon pa'i phyogs su brten nas 'dzin cing sor gdub kyi phreng bas mdzes pa'i phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo'i cha shas kyis pi wang rdung ba la brtson pa/

zhabs gnyis tsog pur bzhugs shing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi smad g.yogs dang stod g.yogs can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ do shal/ gdu bu/ ska rags sogs kyis mdzes pa/ dbu skra mthon mthing ltar mdzes pa'i phyed thur du grol ba'i zar bus sku stod khebs shing*/ phyed gyen du bcings pa'i thor tshugs la me tog gi phreng ba bcings shing*/ rin po che'i gtsug rgyan dang zla ba phyed pas mdzes pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying gyen du bslangs pa'i nang du srog gi ngo bo yi ge oṃ dkar po'i nā da las 'od zer dkar po lcags kyu lta bu dbugs phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig tu sna bug g.yas pa nas 'phros te lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dri za dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba na lha mo dbyangs can ma bzhugs pa'i shangs bug g.yon pa nas zhugs pa shes rab kyi 'khor lo la lcags kyus 'then pa bzhin du reg shangs bug g.yas nas thon/ skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ pṛ tī de wī hrīṃḥpuṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod de/ dbugs rngub pa dang lhan cig tu 'khor lo 'od kyi rnam par rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i aṃ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang gi snying gar dbyangs can ma'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid yi ge hrīṃḥdakar po nā da dang bcas pa gyen du langs pa'i rnam pa can/ mdun nas brtsams te 'dab ma brgyad la g.yas skor gyis rim pa bzhin/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥrnams 'dab ma re re la yi ge gnyis gnyis mar me'i phreng ba ltar dkar zhing 'od gsal ba'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang thams cad bum nang gi mar me'i 'od ltar dkar mer gyis khengs/

mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad sangs/ shes bya thams cad dang khyad par 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la blo gros kyi snang ba thogs med du rgyas lus ngag yid gsum bde ba chen po'i khyab par bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ hrīṃḥzhes brjod pas thugs ka'i hrīṃḥgi nā da las mar me las mar me mched pa ltar hrīṃḥyig gi phreng ba rang gi zhal nas thon/ lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i hrīṃ la thim par bsam zhing*/ hrīṃḥre re brjod pa'i ring la bskor ba re 'khor ba 'gal me'i 'khor lo lta bur myur du 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyis thogs med nas kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dang*/ khyad par mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal/ blo gros kyi snang ba thogs med du rgyas par bsams nas bzla/ yang 'khor lo'i lte ba'i hrīṃ yig las 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang*/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang paṇḍi ta la sogs pa rnams kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi shes rab dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang*/ gza' dang rgyu skar/ nor bu dang sman rtsi bcud dang lo tog rnams kyi bcud/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams stobs dang gzi brjid la sogs pa rnams 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te hrīṃḥyig la thim pas lus thams cad 'od kyis gang*/ 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad bdag nyid la mngon du gyur par bsams la/ tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chad pa ha cang myur ba dang bul ba sogs kyi skyon dang bral bar 'bum phrag nyi khri lnga stong la sogs pa bzla bar gsungs kyang 'bum phrag lnga'am/ rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla bar bya zhing*/ de'i tshe sems can thams cad kyang rang nyid lta bu'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas par gyur te rang dang mnyam du sngags kyi sgra di ri ri bsgrags pas de rnams kyang sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas shes bya thams cad la blo gros kyi snang ba thogs med du rgyas par bsams pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro// thun 'jog khar sngags phreng dang rang gi snying ga'i hrīṃḥyig gi 'od kyis sngar bzhin yon tan thams cad bsdus par bsam pa dang*/

khyad par 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab gang shes 'dod che ba lan gsum du bsdus pas lus kyi nang thams cad dkar mer gyis gang ba la dmigs pa gtad te skad cig gis mi g.yo bar krong gis bsgoms la bsngo ba dang smon lam bya/ de ltar bsgrubs pas rtags 'byung ste/ dngos su sngar bas dran pa gsal zhing lce bde ba dang*/ gzhung mang du 'dzin nus pa dang*/ snyan ngag rtsom 'dod pa sogs dang*/ rmi lam du bu mo yid du 'ong ba rgyan gyis brgyan pas dkar gsum gyi zas byin pa dang*/ shing thog dang rtsi sman sogs byin pa zos pa dang*/ thod le kor dang shing bzang po la sogs pa'am/ rin po che dang me tog gi phreng ba byin pa dang*/ nyi zla shar ba dang*/ me tog 'thu ba dang*/ chu gtsang ma'i rgyu la khrus byed pa sogs 'byung ngo*// de ltar bsgrubs kyang rtag ma byung zhing dmigs pa mi gsal na/ thugs ka'i dbyangs yig rnams mgo nang du bstan nas hrīṃḥyig gi mgo thur du bstan pa lte ba nas thon/ khar zhugs hrīṃḥl thim pa sogs sngar bzhin bsgom pa'am/ yang na yig 'bru rnams 'khrab pa la dmigs pas btud de bsgom par bya ste spogs chog gi dmigs pa'o// sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe bgegs kyi bar chad srung ba'i phyir rta mgrin la sogs pa khro bo gang yang rung ba'i sgom bzlas cung zad bya zhing*/ gnas skabs su dbul ba'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i phyir nor lha gang yang rung ba de la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs kyang bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma bya ba'i tshul ni/ snod gtsang mar dkar gsum gyi gtor ma chab kyis bran/ swā bhā was stong par sbyang*/ oṃ ā hūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun du rang 'dra'i dbyangs can ma spyan drang*/ oṃ swa ra swa tī hrīṃḥ.a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ā dya nutpanna twāt oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul bas ljags nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung ste gtor ma'i bcud thams cad gsol bas mnyes par bsam zhing sngar bzhin arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

ma lus rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul gar// phyag na padmo'i tshems dkar ze'u 'bru las// yid 'phrog 'jo sgeg lha mo'i skur bstan pa// ngag dbang lha mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// kai la sha yi phung po ltar mdzes sku// ston ka'i zla ba lan brgyar phyis pa'i zhal// utpal nags tshal nye bar 'phos pa'i spyan// bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal mnga' khyod la 'dud// zhal nas dbyangs gsal phreng ba'i glu dbyangs dang*// phyag gnyis dri za'i phang 'gro'i sgra snyan gyis// kun gyi rna ba'i bcud len rgyas mdzad ma// zhabs gnyis tsog pu'i tshul gyis 'gying la 'dud// hrīṃḥyig dbyangs gsal phreng ba'i 'od ris can// shes rab 'khor lo snying la dran pas kyang*// 'chad rtsod rtsom la thog pa med pa'i blo// ster mdzad ngag dbang lha mo khyod la 'dud// bshad pas blo gsal tshogs rnams dga' byed cing*// rtsod pas phal rgol ma lus zil gyis gnon// sdeb legs rtsom pas mkhas rnams mgu byed pa'i// 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab bdag la stsol// zhes pas bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab cing dbugs nang du rgyu ba dang lhan cig tu mdun bskyed kyi lha mo rang la thim par bsam/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dag kyang bya'o// ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa zhal shes man ngag gi gnad yongs su rdzogs par bkod pa shes rab kyi snang ba rgyas byed ces bya ba 'di ni rig gnas mtha' dag la thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug chos rgyal chen po rin chen kun dga' chos skyong grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang po'i bkas nye bar bskul ba la brten nas/ btsun pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis dga' ldan pho brang du nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bka' bcu pa yon tan mchog gis bgyis pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/

bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
